description: The cases of SUITE-SDK-PROTO and SUITE-SDK-NET shared by every SDK (PH-1 step 17d, DEC-078; P16–P19 since step 18c, DEC-079). Each SDK's runner implements every case and reports it by its identifier; verify/sdk/sdk_suite.py runs them against a node behind a fault proxy.

SUITE-SDK-PROTO.title: handshake: protocol 1.0 negotiated, the principal named
credentials: password sign-in, API key, bearer token; a wrong password is a typed IAM error, not retried
raw commit: the process, the commits and the new versions
reads with branch, commit, asof and time selectors and their evidence; a missing object is a typed error
paging: every item of a query in pages within one snapshot, unchanged by a commit between pages
port invocation on a branch: the result and the effect
idempotency: the same key returns the first result and commits once; a new key runs again
retries: a reply lost after the commit is retried with the same key and commits once; a stale base is TXN.HEAD_MOVED, not retried
retry classification: exactly the codes the registry marks retryable (and transport failures) are retried
error mapping: node errors are instances of their code's type with area, status and details
subscriptions to an object, a query and events, with cursors and unsubscribe
files: an upload in chunks with progress, resumed from its location after an interruption; whole and ranged downloads verified
exact decimals and money: a 30-digit decimal round-trips exactly; floats are refused at the API boundary
typed API: a polymorphic read and query narrow by class; the builder's DAT-Query matches the text query; a typed port call

branches and merges: a branch from main and from a branch, a merge preview with the change and no conflict, a merge as one process with its commit and versions; a conflicting merge is a typed VER.MERGE_CONFLICT, not retried
change sets: open, submit with its preview, approve by the session's principal, merge with its commit; an action out of state is FLOW.TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED
revert and bulk: a dry run commits nothing, a revert of a process makes one commit and the object no longer reads; a bulk process commits its chunks as children

introspection: the effective class, port dispatch, the head commit with its root, an empty ledger key, a process record with journal and metering, an identical replay; a failed port call names its failed process (BPA 1.0-rc5); an unknown process is IAM.NOT_FOUND

SUITE-SDK-NET.title: connections dropped between requests: the next request reconnects
a connection dropped during a read: the read is retried
300 ms latency each way: operations complete
a 3 s partition: a request made during it completes after it heals
a partition longer than the deadline: a typed, retryable transport error within the deadline
a subscription across dropped connections receives every update committed meanwhile
a node restart: reconnection, re-authentication and the subscription resumed
an upload interrupted by a dropped connection resumes from the node's offset and completes verified
